Rain taps softly against the fogged windows, blurring the distant glow of streetlamps outside. Inside the London pub, golden light spills across battered wood tables and glimmers atop half-drunk pints. The air is thick with the scent of malt and damp wool, laughter and low conversation weaving through the gentle hum of old jazz. Sheltered from the storm, strangers and friends alike draw close, the world outside fading beneath the steady, comforting drumming of rain.
